job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled AI Backend Developer with 2 to 7 years of experience to develop backend systems that support AI features, APIs, and data processing. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in AI development and excellent problem-solving skills.



Roles and Responsibility




Design and develop scalable backend systems that support AI features and APIs.


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and prioritize project requirements.


Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.


Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues efficiently.


Participate in code reviews and ensure high-quality code standards.


Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in AI and backend development.




Job Requirements




Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.


Experience with AI frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Keras.


Knowledge of database management systems such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.


Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.




About Company



Nitsan Technologies is a leading company in the industry, committed to developing innovative AI solutions. We offer a dynamic and supportive work environment, with opportunities for professional growth and development.
